summary: Performs lookup-table-based convolution with error diffusion over a row of pixel data. For each of a4 output rows: zero-fills the destination buffer, then per channel reads a source pointer and convolves each byte through index tables on the context object (context +16/+24/+68), accumulating scaled error into a diffusion row buffer and writing the weighted error (3/5/7 factors) back into the table. Scan direction alternates per row based on a direction byte on the context, producing serpentine scanning. Calls MemoryZeroFill to clear each row. Returns the last direction-flag value. ABI lead names this Pixel_Data_Convolution_via_Lookup_Table (LEGACY).

operations.description: Read per-row state from the object: v30 = a1[25] (this+0x64, channel count per row), v4 = a1[105] (this+0x1A4, context pointer), v5 = a1[71] (this+0x11C, byte stride added in the inner lookup), v28 = a1[23] (this+0x5C, row byte count).
Process rows only when the row count a4 is greater than 0.
Outer loop over a4 output rows, advancing the row-pointer array v32 by one pointer per iteration.
Call MemoryZeroFill(*v32, v28) to clear the current output row buffer before convolution.

Per-channel scan direction: when the context byte at +84 is nonzero, set up reverse scanning (direction -1, destination and source pointers offset to row end, stride negated, table pointer advanced by 2*v28 + 2); otherwise forward scanning (direction +1, table at base).
Per channel, load the two convolution tables: v19 = value at 4*v31 past context +24 and v18 = value at 4*v31 past context +16.

Inner loop over v28 byte positions: index a source byte through the direction-offset table entry, accumulate the second lookup value into the destination (*v9 += v13), compute the quantization error v17, and distribute it via the 3/5/7 scaled accumulators (v26, v25, v11) written back into the table row.
After each channel completes, write the trailing accumulator value v26 into the table at the final pointer position.
After each row, toggle the scan-direction flag: set context byte +84 to (old flag == 0), giving alternating left-to-right / right-to-left serpentine scanning across rows.
Return v5, the last direction-flag value produced by the row loop.
